h1: Mental Health and Addiction Center in Mechanicsburg, PA
hero_sub: Serving Mechanicsburg and Cumberland County, Arkview offers personalized addiction and mental health care — detox, residential, and outpatient programs, all under one roof. Evidence-based. 24/7 admissions.
intro: If you or someone you love is struggling with addiction, substance use, or a mental health condition, help is closer than you think. Arkview's Mechanicsburg campus provides a full continuum of care, from medically supervised detox and residential treatment through intensive outpatient and aftercare. As one of only a handful of Pennsylvania providers with separate, dedicated facilities for mental health and substance use, we make sure each program fits what you're actually here for. You don't have to navigate this alone.

local_impact: Like much of Pennsylvania, Cumberland County has been hit hardest by opioids and alcohol, with methamphetamine use climbing in recent years. Co-occurring mental health conditions — depression, anxiety, PTSD — frequently show up alongside substance use. Arkview's Mechanicsburg campus sits in the center of the county and serves individuals and families across the greater Harrisburg area, so clinical-grade care stays close to home.

faqs.q: Is Arkview currently accepting new admissions?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Mechanicsburg campus admits 24/7, and most admissions happen within 24–48 hours of your first call.

faqs.q: Does Arkview accept my insurance in Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: We're in-network with most major commercial plans. Call and we'll verify your benefits at no cost, usually within minutes.

faqs.q: What's the difference between residential and outpatient treatment?
faqs.a: Residential means living on-site with around-the-clock care. Outpatient (PHP and IOP) means structured treatment during the day while you live at home.

faqs.q: Can I bring my phone or personal belongings?
faqs.a: Our admissions team will walk you through exactly what to bring and our policies before you arrive.

faqs.q: Does Arkview treat mental health conditions alongside addiction?
faqs.a: Yes — we run separate, dedicated programs for mental health and substance use, so each one gets focused care.

faqs.q: How long does treatment typically last?
faqs.a: A few days for detox, several weeks for residential and outpatient.

final_cta.title: Ready to Take the First Step Toward Recovery?
final_cta.sub: Our team is here 24/7 — free, confidential, no obligation.

You don't have to navigate this alone.
